headline: As of 2026-09-26: 337,121 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 20 of 50 states, D+46.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 337,121 early/mail ballots cast so far across 20 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+46.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (182,908), New Jersey (55,021), Wisconsin (29,902).
